rationale: Use own colour and coordinates modulo 3. In demonstration 1, zeros at (0,1), (0,2), and (1,1) map to 4, 5, and 6; demonstration 3 repeats these mappings at columns 4 and 5. Zero at residue (2,1) maps to 3; nonzero colours remain unchanged.

Use own colour and row/column parity. Demonstration 1 maps zeros on even/odd coordinates to 3, odd/even to 4, and odd/odd to 2. Colour 2 on even/even coordinates becomes 7, as at (0,4); other colours retain their values.
Use own colour and border status. Demonstration 1 maps interior colours 1, 2, and 3 to 4, 5, and 9, while border 3 becomes 0 and border 1 and 2 remain unchanged. Zeros remain 0 throughout.

Use own colour plus row and column sets excluding 0. Demonstration 1 maps zero to 4 for row set {1,2,3} and column set {2}, and to 5 for row set {1,2} and column set {3}. Demonstration 7 maps 3 to 7 for row set {2,3} and column set {1,3}.

Use own colour and the row set excluding 0. Demonstration 1 changes 1 to 8 in rows containing {1,2}, and zero to 4 in rows containing {2,3}. Demonstration 2 changes zero to 7 and 2 to 6 in its final row containing {1,2,3}.

Use own colour plus row and column sets excluding 0. Demonstration 4 changes 3 to 2 when both sets are {1,2,3}, and 2 to 4 when the row set is {1,2,3} and column set is {1,2}. Demonstration 10 maps zero to 6 and 3 to 5 for row set {1,3} and column set {2,3}.
Use own colour and border status. Demonstration 1 maps border zeros to 4, interior zeros to 5, interior 2 to 0, and border 3 to 9. Border 2, interior 3, and all 1s retain their colours.

Use own colour and the row set excluding 0. Demonstration 3 fills zeros with 1 for row sets {2,3} or {1}, with 3 for {3}, and with 2 for {1,3}. Rows containing {1,2} or {1,2,3} remain unchanged, as demonstrated by the first two pairs.
Use own colour and border status. Demonstration 2 maps border zero to 2, interior zero to 3, border 1 to 0, and border 2 to 4. Interior 1 and 2 and all 3s remain unchanged.

Use the full 3x3 neighbourhood including out-of-grid values. In demonstration 5, bottom-row zeros at columns 3 and 4 become 8: both have two all-zero neighbourhood rows above an out-of-grid row. All other demonstrated neighbourhoods preserve the centre colour.
